services.name: RTR Pilates
services.desc: Pilates is more than just a fitness trend; it’s a holistic workout system that has been transforming bodies and lives for over a century. Rooted in the teachings of its creator, Joseph Pilates, this practice focuses on developing core strength, enhancing flexibility, improving balance, and fostering mind-body awareness. Pilates places a strong emphasis on building a stable and powerful core. Strengthening the muscles of the abdomen, lower back, and pelvis creates a solid foundation for all movements and helps maintain healthy posture. The controlled and precise movements of Pilates exercises promote flexibility in both muscles and joints. This increased flexibility can alleviate stiffness
